description: This Java class is a command handler for unblocking debits from a savings account within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, handles a specific command type, and delegates the unblocking operation to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UnblockDebitsFromSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the command to unblock debits from a specific savings account, identified via command payload, by delegating to the savings account service.

methods.name: UnblockDebitsFromSavingsAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to unblock debits by invoking the service layer with the savings account ID obtained from the command.
